rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any person to sell, license, or provide an algorithmic rent-setting device to a landlord, and unlawful for a landlord to use such a device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.key_value: civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties within the City of San Diego.

rules.exemptions: Does not apply to software publishing reports from aggregated historical nonpublic data older than 90 days or public information without recommending future rates, nor to software used to establish rates or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11 (Sections 98.1101-98.1104)
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
